newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Ayala Land to declassify shares.
newsitem.headline: Ayala Land to declassify shares.

text.p: Philippine property firm Ayala Land Inc said on Wednesday it will declassify its B shares and list its A shares.
In a statement, Ayala Land said the declassification was a response to a request by the Philippine Stock Exchange (PSE) made in April last year.

Ayala Land assistant corporate secretary Renato Marzan said that it was the stock exchange that invited the company to list its outstanding A shares and to consider declassifying its common shares prior to applying for the listing of the unlisted outstanding shares.
"The declassification of ALI A and B shares will not result in any dilution since it does not involve issuance of any new shares," Ayala Land said.
Ayala Land said the declassification is consistent with market reforms being instituted by the stock exchange.
